cases.expect: Exact physical, magic, sword formulas; minimum one; defense and fractional coefficients.
Every monster has ten stats, 3-5 valid skills, unique IDs and shared executors.
Seed replay, variety across 200 seeds, contextual weights, resources/cooldowns, anti-repeat, target lock.
All 16 skills execute with warnings, formula damage, costs and bounded hits; dodge/guard/pause. Renderer warning/active inspected with reduced effects.
Old saves and added catalog IDs preserve entries; production victory against both monsters and actual defeat-to-map; bag and charge intact.
Ground wave travels with jump counterplay; eruption three locked timed sites; fang slow affects movement, expires, blocked by guard/iframe.
All four map monsters use four-frame alpha atlas; per-region movement through full loop and reduced-motion freeze.

gaps: No long-term human balance study or real-mobile QA.
Sword formula tested, but no sword skill in current monster catalog and no player cultivation-class selection.
Sixteen-skill visual fixture uses Vite source; production browser covers real fights, not a forced run of every individual skill.
No Firefox/Safari run, heap audit, reward/economy system, or new-map combat.
